title: Relic Hunters Legend
tagline: A looter-shooter legend in the making — run the story, raise a Hunter to 30, and craft your first Relic.
order_note: Chapters in story order, following one full playthrough's unlock sequence; the progression achievements pop whenever their totals land, so they may arrive earlier or later than listed.
scope_note: Full game: all 18 achievements / 1,000G. No TrueAchievements walkthrough exists; chapter order follows a completed playthrough's unlock sequence. About 40–50 hours.

sources.label: mygamerprofile — GS values and unlock order

achievements.name: A Legend is Born
achievements.how: Complete the “A Legend is Born” Adventure.

achievements.name: Act 3
achievements.how: Complete the “Act 3” chapter — the story finale.

achievements.name: Rebel Crew
achievements.how: Unlock a new Hunter — there are seven playable hunters, and new ones unlock as you progress the story.

achievements.name: Making Progress
achievements.req: Level Up a Hunter to Level 6

achievements.name: Treasure Hunter
achievements.how: Complete a Treasure Map — maps unlock via coordinates found in regular missions and lead to unique loot.

achievements.name: Relic Hunter
achievements.how: Craft your first Relic — relics surface from story progress, Adventures, Treasure Maps, and Item World.

achievements.name: All the way up!
achievements.req: Level Up a Hunter to Level 30
achievements.how: Level one Hunter to 30 — the long grind of the list. Mix Scavenge, Skirmish, and Treasure Maps for efficient XP, and use the Material Exchange Shop to round out crafting resources. Stick to one Hunter for this.
